SELECT
  time_bucket,
  COUNT(*) AS games,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN ((home_team_id = 1 AND home_score > away_score)
         OR (away_team_id = 1 AND away_score > home_score))
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) AS wins,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN ((home_team_id = 1 AND home_score < away_score)
         OR (away_team_id = 1 AND away_score < home_score))
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) AS losses,
  SUM(
    CASE
      WHEN ((home_team_id = 1 OR away_team_id = 1) AND home_score = away_score)
      THEN 1 ELSE 0 END
  ) AS ties
FROM (
  SELECT
    *,
    CASE
      WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM game_time) < 18 THEN 'before_6pm'
      WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM game_time) >= 18
           AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM game_time) < 19 THEN '6_to_7pm'
      WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM game_time) >= 19
           AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM game_time) < 20 THEN '7_to_8pm'
      WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM game_time) >= 20
           AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM game_time) < 21 THEN '8_to_9pm'
      WHEN EXTRACT(HOUR FROM game_time) >= 21
           AND EXTRACT(HOUR FROM game_time) < 22 THEN '9_to_10pm'
      ELSE 'after_10pm'
    END AS time_bucket
  FROM public.game
  WHERE (home_team_id = 1 OR away_team_id = 1)
    AND game_status = 'completed'
) g
GROUP BY time_bucket
ORDER BY
  CASE time_bucket
    WHEN 'before_6pm' THEN 1
    WHEN '6_to_7pm' THEN 2
    WHEN '7_to_8pm' THEN 3
    WHEN '8_to_9pm' THEN 4
    WHEN '9_to_10pm' THEN 5
    WHEN 'after_10pm' THEN 6
    ELSE 7
  END;
